藏品名称_EN: Changsha kiln brown glaze molded applique double ear jar
藏品名称_ZN: 长沙窑褐釉模印贴花双耳罐
描述_EN: A brown-glazed, molded and appliquéd amphora from the Changsha kilns，your (honorific)19.2centimetre，caliber12.6centimetre，footsteps14.2centimetre。　　lip of the can，straight neck，shoulder augmentation，rounded abdomen，submental convergence (medicine)，flat bottomed。The tire is grayish white，Brownish-yellowish glaze。Symmetrical square lugs and four die-stamped appliqués on shoulders。Plain and unglazed near the foot for one week and at the base。　　Tang dynasty Changsha kiln wares are mainly daily-use ceramics，In addition to meeting domestic needs，It's also exported in large quantities.。Its shape is simple and plain，Speaking of nuance，Most common in various forms of cans and jars。Early decorative use of color in molded appliquéd figures、footwork、Large brown or green colored spots on grapes，Then it developed into painting with a single brown or green color，Gradually evolve to the use of brown、Green two-tone colored。The Changsha kilns of the Tang Dynasty were the birthplace of mass-produced underglaze porcelain in China，It creates a new way of colorful decoration of porcelain。　　Tang Dynasty Changsha Kiln Porcelain Characteristics，First was the invention of underglaze painting，Breaking through the single glaze color of celadon。Secondly, there is a wide range of underglaze painting subjects，informative，Involving Landscape、character (in a play, novel etc)、painting of birds and flowers, etc.，Lively subject matter，With realism。The third is the extensive use of molded appliqués.，and inscribed with a five-character poem or six-character folk song in brown color。The trend began at the Changsha kiln，Developed to its peak in the Song and Yuan dynasties。
描述_ZN: A white glazed green-colored pillow from Changsha kilns, 9.5 cm high, 16.5 cm long, 10 cm wide.　　The pillow is rectangular, with rounded corners and a hole on one side. Pillow surface white glaze ground, the central green color painted with four diamond-shaped flowers combined into a large diamond-shaped pattern, the four corners and each painted with a small flower pattern. Glaze surface open small pattern piece, the bottom without glaze.　　This pillow is small and elegant, typical of porcelain pillows of the Tang Dynasty. The pattern is simple, the painting style is fresh, a few strokes, the meaning is full of interest. From this pillow, we can see the Changsha kiln craftsman's skill in integrating traditional painting techniques into ceramic decoration.
